notes.title: New visuals and demo updates!
notes.content:
Demo updates
Since June, we’ve been hard at work making the Demo the best it can be! Here’s what’s new:

New content: Second map (Snowy Snowers), tutorial, Gem ability system, unlockables, Miner health system, and more augments & gems.

Systems & features: Miner passives, helper tools for new players, and better visual clarity.

Quality of life: Steam Deck support, Gem list, accessibility settings, camera edge panning, and loads of polish.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465950/f86741ab63925812ef90f7a0d9bbf6ef90898fcf.png"]
New Visuals
Brand new visuals! We’ve refreshed the look with a new logo, Steam page art, and a shiny animated main menu!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465950/c27c0f94758eeeabe51dba0dc3fc2e92e4dce897.png"]
Skins are coming with the full release! 🎉
Skins are coming with full release! Demo players will receive an exclusive skin, and your save file will carry over into the full game. We’re also planning a small supporter pack at launch that would include a few skins. Skins will be unlocked through hard-earned achievements.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465950/1fb68104037cafdeacead65ec651db116f6bcd18.png"]
What's Next for Gem Miner TD
Stay tuned, more demo updates (and some secret cool stuff) are coming before Finnish Games Week and Next Fest early next month.

The release date will be revealed later this month/early next, and we will make sure the game launches with a big discount!

-iFeral
